spec_match.rationale: Observes the two spec behaviours that distinguish zip from hand-rolled loops — per-step lazy pulling and closing of abandoned iterators — with counters and finally-hooks on real generators.

interactive.rationale: Walk/stop-early controls run the generators and the close ledger updates with real finally-block timestamps (verified via button).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises observable behaviours, not descriptions — the counters and close hooks deliver.

edge_cases.rationale: Early break, mode-dependent closing and the mapping-function-throws path are all exercised.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite's closing assertion mirrors this page's contract; 8/8 native pass.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Live run showed pulls per source and all abandoned iterators closed (allSettled true); console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: abandoned-iterators-closed asserts allSettled — falsifiable and exactly the spec contract.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons named, ledger rows textual, aria-live output, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. The close-ledger design proves the cleanup contract with falsifiable telemetry — the strongest page of the feature.
